examples.problem: Find the inverse Laplace transform for $F(s) = \dfrac{3}{s^2 + 9}.$
examples.worked_solution:
From the table of Laplace transforms, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}L{\operatorname{sin}⁡3t} & =\frac{3}{{s}^{2}+{3}^{2}}=\frac{3}{{s}^{2}+9},\,s>0.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{L}^{-1}{\frac{3}{{s}^{2}+9}} & ={L}^{-1}{L{\operatorname{sin}⁡3t}} \\  & =\operatorname{sin}⁡3t.\end{aligned}
$$
